entities.summary: Jordan Hicks is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker for 10 seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played for the Philadelphia Eagles, with whom he won a Super Bowl ring in 2018, the Arizona Cardinals, Minnesota Vikings, and Cleveland Browns. He played college football for the Texas Longhorns.
